__help: A value left out (or a broken file): the default of the mod.
Fee (spirit stones) = total value x FeeRate + FeeMinCost. Reputation cost = total value x DegreeCostRate + DegreeMinCost.
CostTime: months per item, by item level 1-6 (the items add up). SuccessRate: chance in %, by item level 1-6 (the lowest of the items, + luck / 100).
CostTime and SuccessRate: 6 values; missing ones: the defaults.
